get.description: Retrieve a list of properties for a specified object type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to filter results based on archived status and control pagination through query parameters. It is useful for obtaining metadata about object properties, such as their labels, types, and other attributes.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type whose properties are being retrieved.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A paging cursor token for pagination. Use the value from the previous response's paging.next.after field to retrieve the next set of results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: A list of specific fields to include in the response. Possible values include category, label, type, fieldType, and more.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 25.

post.description: Create a new property for a specified object type in your HubSpot account. This operation requires specifying the object type ID and providing the necessary property details in the request body. The newly created property will be returned upon successful creation.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which the property is being created.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Archive multiple properties for a specified object type in a batch operation. This endpoint allows you to efficiently manage the archival of properties by processing them in bulk, which can be useful when you need to clean up or reorganize properties within your CRM schema.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type whose properties you want to archive.

post.description: Create multiple properties in a batch for a specified object type in HubSpot. This endpoint allows you to define and create several properties at once, streamlining the process of setting up new properties for your CRM objects. It is useful for initializing or updating your CRM schema with new data fields efficiently.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which properties are being created.

post.description: Purge multiple properties in a batch operation for a specified object type. This endpoint allows you to permanently delete properties associated with an object type in your HubSpot account. It is useful for cleaning up unused or obsolete properties in bulk.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type whose properties are to be purged.

post.description: Retrieve a batch of properties for a specified object type in HubSpot. This endpoint allows you to specify which fields to include in the response, enabling efficient data retrieval for multiple properties at once. It is useful for applications that need to access detailed property information in bulk.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which properties are being retrieved.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: An array of field names to include in the response. Valid values include 'category', 'label', 'type', 'fieldType', 'groupName', 'description', 'options', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt', 'hidden', 'readOnlyValue', 'readOnlyDefinition', 'hasUniqueValue', 'archivable', 'readOnlyOptions', 'calculationFormula', 'archived', 'calculated', 'optionsSource', 'dateDisplayFormat', 'numberDisplayFormat', 'currencyPropertyName', 'updatedByUserId', 'createdByUserId', 'dataEntryInstructions', 'optionColors', 'accessAllowlist', 'dataSensitivity', 'defaultValue', 'formField', 'sensitiveDataCategories', 'validationRules', 'rollupConfig', 'syncConfig'.

post.description: Restore a batch of previously archived properties for a specified object type in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful for recovering multiple properties that were archived and need to be reactivated. The request requires specifying the object type ID and the properties to restore.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type whose properties are being restored.

post.description: Update multiple properties for a specified object type in a single request. This endpoint allows for efficient modification of property details, streamlining the process of managing object schemas in bulk. It is particularly useful for updating properties across different objects without making multiple API calls.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type whose properties are to be updated.

get.description: Retrieve option values for a given optionsSource. This endpoint allows you to get the available options for a property with externally sourced options denoted via an optionsSource value, which can be useful for understanding the possible values that a property can take. The results can be paginated using the 'after' parameter.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type whose property options are being retrieved.

parameters.name: optionSource
parameters.description: The specific source of the options for the property being queried.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 25.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific property of an object type in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to specify which fields of the property to include in the response, providing flexibility in the data you receive.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type whose property is being retrieved.

parameters.name: propertyName
parameters.description: The name of the property to retrieve information about.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: A list of property fields to include in the response. Valid fields include category, label, type, fieldType, groupName, description, options, createdAt, updatedAt, hidden, readOnlyValue, readOnlyDefinition, hasUniqueValue, archivable, readOnlyOptions, calculationFormula, archived, calculated, optionsSource, dateDisplayFormat, numberDisplayFormat, currencyPropertyName, updatedByUserId, createdByUserId, dataEntryInstructions, optionColors, accessAllowlist, dataSensitivity, defaultValue, formField, sensitiveDataCategories, validationRules, rollupConfig, and syncConfig.

delete.description: Delete a specific property from a CRM object schema in your HubSpot account. This operation is irreversible and removes the property from the specified object type, identified by its unique objectTypeId and propertyName.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type from which the property will be deleted.

parameters.name: propertyName
parameters.description: The name of the property to be deleted from the object type.

patch.description: Update an existing property for a specified object type in your HubSpot account. This operation allows you to modify the details of a property, such as its label, type, or other configurations. Ensure that the property name and object type ID are correctly specified to successfully update the desired property.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type whose property you want to update.

parameters.name: propertyName
parameters.description: The name of the property to update.
